title: Audiometry once between 18 and 21

source.quote: Screen with audiometry including 6,000 and 8,000 Hz high frequencies once between 11 and 14 years, once between 15 and 17 years, and once between 18 and 21 years.

gold_notes: Only the 18-21 band encoded; 11-14 and 15-17 bands are analogous. Age-anchored window approximated.
